blocks.text: UNITED NATION, United States — Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa insisted at the United Nations Wednesday that the Golan Heights is Syrian land, dismissing Colombia’s recognition of Israeli sovereignty over the strategic plateau. Israel captured the Golan Heights from Syria in the Six Day War of 1967 and annexed the territory in 1981. The United States had been the only country to recognize this annexation until Colombia’s new hard-right, US-aligned government in August recognized Israel’s claim over the Golan.
